SWFG.Title: Combat (Fantasy Grounds style)
SWFG.Empty: No combatants. Select tokens and press “Add selected”.
SWFG.Hint: Right-click a row: the same options as the SWADE tracker (update combatant, group by name, make group leader…). Drag a combatant onto another to make it follow. Click a card to view it, right-click to redraw. Click Wounds or Fatigue to mark, right-click to remove one; right-click Bennies to add one.

Tooltip.DealAll: Deal cards to everyone without one

Notify.WrongSystem: SWADE – FG-style Combat Tracker only works with the SWADE system.

AutoOpen.Name: Open when combat starts
AutoOpen.Hint: Opens the window automatically when combat starts in the scene you are viewing.

NpcDetail.Name: NPC info visible to players
NpcDetail.Hint: What players see of combatants that don't belong to any player.

StatusList.Name: Statuses on each row
StatusList.Hint: Comma-separated SWADE status ids, in display order.

GMBennies.Name: Show GM Bennies
GMBennies.Hint: Shows the GM Benny counter in the header.

ThemeClient.Name: Colour theme (just you)
ThemeClient.Hint: Overrides the world theme in this browser only.

FavoritesMode.Name: Show favourites
FavoritesMode.Hint: When items marked as favourite on the sheet appear in the row (only for whoever controls the character).
FavoritesMode.Expanded: Only when the row is expanded

FavoriteTypes.Name: Favourite types
FavoriteTypes.Hint: Favourite item types to show, comma-separated and in order (weapon, power, action, consumable, gear, shield, armor, skill, edge, hindrance, ability). "all" shows every favourite.

NpcAttackTypes.Name: NPC attacks without star
NpcAttackTypes.Hint: Item types always shown in the NPC row even if not marked as favourite. Powers appear when the row is expanded. Leave empty to show favourites only.

RollEngine.Name: Rolls from the tracker
RollEngine.Hint: Which module handles favourite rolls. Better Rolls 2 follows its click setting (card, dialog or direct roll); SWADE Tools opens its attack dialog.

PanOnTurn.Name: Pan to the active combatant
PanOnTurn.Hint: Moves the camera to the token of whoever's turn it is.
PanOnTurn.Mine: Only when I change the turn

PanSelect.Name: Also select the token
PanSelect.Hint: When panning, select the token if you own it (the GM selects any NPC).

AutoExpand.Name: Expand the active combatant
AutoExpand.Hint: When the turn changes, expands the effects, stats and powers section of the acting combatant and collapses the previous one.

Fav.ShowCard: Open the roll (Better Rolls 2 / SWADE Tools / system)

CardViewer.Title: Action card
CardViewer.Missing: The combatant is no longer in combat.
